appearance: POS surfaces use opaque shared card/background/border tokens, flatter shadows and shared corner radii. Existing product/cart placement, dimensions, controls and responsive workflow remain.
Selected payment controls and receipt registry action groups are flatter; sticky horizontal-scroll affordance remains.
Registers, shifts, sales and purchase headers use full shared border tokens; fields and actions retain their established order.

explicitInteractionChanges.behavior: Translated accessible names for opening cash/note, register create/edit names/codes, cash movement and shift closing fields; history return quantity is named using product and remaining quantity. No new translations needed.

explicitInteractionChanges.before: During a responsive switch with the discount sheet, the first QA cart displayed gross 300 while its persisted total was 270. The receipt detail query was disabled whenever optimistic local lines existed.
explicitInteractionChanges.after: Fetch saved receipt metadata if the detail cache is cold even when optimistic lines exist, while retaining the warm-cache scanning optimization.
explicitInteractionChanges.replay: Fresh tab restored 270. Final build: new draft 162.50, fixed discount 12.50, total 150; open discount, desktop/mobile switch and close retained 150. Draft was canceled without stock or payment posting.
explicitInteractionChanges.limit: Old unfinished-cart reload attempts were blocked by the existing navigation guard; they are not evidence of a failed hard reload.

explicitInteractionChanges.behavior: POS journal and standalone history display the authoritative read-only server quote, wait while loading, expose error/retry and disable completion until a valid selection quote is available. Both handlers re-fetch the actual return draft amount before posting; zero-value returns use no payment.

explicitInteractionChanges.before: A desktop-to-mobile transition while a nested POS return dialog was open remounted shared helpers and lost accessible control names.
explicitInteractionChanges.after: Customer edit, receipt journal, sale detail, return and cart price-sync helpers render once at the common POS root. They remain mounted through responsive view changes; fields/actions are unchanged.

explicitInteractionChanges.before: After desktop journal -> return -> 390px -> cancel, focus fell to BODY; Tab reached a focus guard outside the dialog.
explicitInteractionChanges.after: Modal remembers its opening parent dialog. If the original trigger was removed or cannot receive focus after responsive hiding, it focuses the still-connected parent. Existing explicit return-focus refs retain precedence.
explicitInteractionChanges.browserReplay: Production build: same resize/cancel sequence focused the Journal dialog; native Tab moved to its Close button and stayed inside. Accessible names remained.
explicitInteractionChanges.unitLimit: The new jsdom runtime case covers a removed original trigger and also passes before this fix. The hidden-desktop-trigger regression is established by the real production browser replay, not by jsdom layout.

explicitInteractionChanges.before: The purchase family fell through to brand as the contextual page title, producing BAZAAR twice in the mobile header.
explicitInteractionChanges.after: Purchase list, create and detail use the existing translated purchaseOrders navigation title.

explicitInteractionChanges.behavior: Corrected timestamp bindings to keep reservation expiry and sweeping independent of the PostgreSQL session TimeZone. Earn/spend formulas and expiry duration are unchanged.
